title: MiniMax and Zhipu Erase Combined $150B in Market Value
summary:
Shares of Chinese AI developers MiniMax and Zhipu have dropped more than 80% from their respective all-time highs, with MiniMax falling 87% and Zhipu declining 81%. MiniMax's valuation previously peaked at 650% above its March initial public offering price before sliding below that level.

The companies have lost a combined $150B in market value since they debuted in January. The selloff follows a token price war among US and Chinese firms, including OpenAI and Anthropic, that has squeezed the profitability of the still-unprofitable startups. Additional downward pressure may come from prospective IPOs by DeepSeek and Moonshot AI, or the 203 million pre-IPO shares of MiniMax and Zhipu that become eligible for trading in January.

AI stocks are COLLAPSING in China:

The selloff comes as Chinese and US AI companies slash token prices, intensifying competition and putting further pressure on the profitability of both firms, which remain unprofitable.

Despite launching new models with lower costs and improved performance, neither company has managed to reverse its stock decline.

Moreover, their latest offerings continue to trail leading US models in intelligence.

Meanwhile, potential IPOs by DeepSeek and Moonshot AI could further draw investor money away from MiniMax and Z AI.

In addition, pre-IPO investors in both companies will be allowed to sell their shares, which could add further selling pressure.

Intensifying competition is putting growing pressure on AI stocks.

🚨China's AI model trade is getting DESTROYED.

Bloomberg reports that MiniMax and Zhipu have erased a combined $150 BILLION from their peaks. MiniMax went from +650% above its IPO price in March to trading BELOW its IPO price. Zhipu has crashed 81% from its June high.

And the squeeze is getting worse. OpenAI and Anthropic have joined the token price war to narrow Chinese models' cost advantage, while MiniMax and Zhipu remain unprofitable. DeepSeek and Moonshot AI could IPO next year, and another 203 million pre-IPO MiniMax and Zhipu shares become eligible for trading in January.
